He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball|Notre Dame Fighting Irish]], [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt Commodores]], and [[Chattanooga Mocs men's basketball|Chattanooga Mocs]].{{cite web|title=Matt Ryan - 2019-20 Men's Basketball 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211126183742/https://gomocs.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/matt-ryan/6880|url-status=live}} ==High school career== Ryan attended [[Iona Preparatory School]] where he led the Gaels to a 22–6 record en route to the program's first Class AA Archdiocesan Championship while averaging 20 points, eight rebounds, and five assists per game as a senior, while also being named [[Mr. New York Basketball]].{{cite news|first=Evan|last=Fallor|title=Iona Prep’s Matt Ryan named New York’s Mr. Basketball|url=https://www.lohud.com/story/sports/high-school/basketball/2015/03/19/iona-preps-matt-ryan-named-new-yorks-mr-basketball/25055145/|website=lohud.com|date=March 19, 2015|access-date=April 24, 2022}} He was also named a first-team [[Parade All-America Boys Basketball Team|''Parade'' All-American]].{{cite news|first=Brian|last=McLaughlin|title=Meet Parade's 2015 All-America Basketball Teams|url=http://parade.com/401074/brianmclaughlin/meet-parades-2015-all-america-basketball-teams/|website=Parade.com|date=May 29, 2015|access-date=April 13, 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150530001949/http://parade.com/401074/brianmclaughlin/meet-parades-2015-all-america-basketball-teams/|archive-date=May 30, 2015|url-status=live}} ==College career== Ryan began his college career at [[Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball|Notre Dame]], where he played sparingly before transferring to [[Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball|Vanderbilt]] after his sophomore season.{{cite news|first=Jesse|last=Johnson|title=Vanderbilt gains Notre Dame transfer Matt Ryan|url=https://247sports.com/college/vanderbilt/Article/Notre-Dame-PF-transfer-Matt-Ryan-chooses-Vanderbilt-52483834/|work=247 Sports|date=April 25, 2017|access-date=December 19, 2021}} As a junior, he averaged 8.1 points and 2.7 rebounds per game. Following the season, Ryan transferred to [[Chattanooga Mocs men's basketball|Chattanooga]].{{cite news|first=Adam|last=Sparks|title=Vanderbilt basketball: Matt Ryan transfers to Chattanooga, trims Jerry Stackhouse's first team|url=https://www.tennessean.com/story/sports/college/vanderbilt/2019/05/01/vanderbilt-basketball-matt-ryan-transfer-chattanooga/3647986002/|work=[[The Tennessean]]|date=May 2, 2019|access-date=December 19, 2021}} As a senior, he had his best season, playing 33 games and averaging 15.4 points, 4.9 rebounds, and 1.9 assists in 30.6 minutes per game, while shooting 42.3 percent from the field, 35.9 percent from [[three-point field goal|three-point]] range and 87.9 percent from the free-throw line. ==Professional career== Ryan went undrafted in the [[2020 NBA draft]]. His prospects were limited by the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], and he did not land a spot in the [[G League]]'s bubble in [[2020–21 NBA G League season|2020–21]].{{cite news|first=Kyle|last=Goon|title=Matt Ryan survives cuts, makes Lakers’ roster|url=https://www.ocregister.com/2022/10/15/matt-ryan-survives-cuts-makes-lakers-roster/|work=The Orange County Register|date=October 15, 2022|access-date=December 1, 2022}} He resorted to working for DoorDash and UberEats while coaching a grassroots basketball team. He also worked at a cemetery in [[Yonkers, New York]].{{cite web|first=Jack|last=Baer|title=Lakers' Matt Ryan goes from DoorDash driver to buzzer-beater hero in much-needed win over Pelicans|url=https://au.sports.yahoo.com/lakers-matt-ryan-goes-from-door-dash-driver-to-buzzer-beater-hero-in-much-needed-win-over-pelicans-053357567.html|website=Yahoo.com|date=November 3, Celtics (2022)=== On February 28, 2022, Ryan signed a two-way contract with the [[Boston Celtics]].{{cite web|first=Kyle|last=George|title=Celtics Sign Matt Ryan To Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/celtics/news/pressrelease/celtics-sign-matt-ryan-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=February 28, 2022|access-date=February 28, 2022}} He averaged 20.4 points in 14 games for the [[Maine Red Claws]] to finish the [[2021–22 NBA G League season]]. He made his first and only appearance for the Celtics on April 10, 2022, against the [[Memphis Grizzlies]], scoring three points in five minutes.{{cite web|title=Matt Ryan 2021-22 Game Log|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/players/r/ryanma01/gamelog/2022|website=Basketball-Reference.com|access-date=November 2, 2022}} The Celtics made it to the [[2022 NBA Finals]], where they lost to the [[Golden State Warriors]] in six games.{{cite web|first=Tim|last=Reynolds|title=Celtics take bitter with sweet after losing in NBA Finals|url=https://www.nba.com/news/celtics-take-bitter-with-sweet-after-losing-in-nba-finals|website=NBA.com|date=June 17, 2022|access-date=February 21, 2024}} Ryan joined the Celtics for the [[2022 NBA Summer League]]. ===Los Angeles Lakers (2022)=== On September 26, 2022, Ryan signed with the [[Los Angeles Lakers]].{{cite web|title=Lakers Sign Dwayne Bacon and Matt Ryan|url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/news/lakers-sign-dwayne-bacon-and-matt-ryan-092622?amp=1|website=NBA.com|date=September 26, 2022|access-date=September 27, 2022}} He made 37.5% of his 3-pointers in the preseason and earned the final spot on the team's 15-man roster out of training camp.{{cite news|first=Dan|last=Woike|title=LeBron James, Austin Reaves power Lakers over Trail Blazers|url=https://www.latimes.com/sports/lakers/story/2022-11-30/lebron-james-austin-reaves-power-lakers-over-trail-blazers|work=Los Angeles Times|date=November 30, 2022|access-date=December 1, 2022|quote=The team also will waive wing Matt Ryan, who made the team as the 15th player out of training camp.}} On November 2, he hit a corner 3-pointer to tie the game at the regulation buzzer against the [[New Orleans Pelicans]], with the Lakers going on to win 120–117 in overtime. He had missed six of his first seven 3-point attempts against the Pelicans and finished the game with 11 points.{{Cite web |date=November 2, 2022 |title=Ryan forces OT, Lakers rally for 120-117 win over Pelicans |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap/_/gameId/401468272 |access-date=November 3, 2022 |website=ESPN.com|agency=Associated Press}} Ryan was waived by the Lakers on December 1.{{cite web|title=Lakers Waive Matt Ryan|url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/news/lakers-waive-matt-ryan-12-1-22|website=NBA.com|date=December 1, 2022|access-date=December 3, 2022}} ===Minnesota Timberwolves / Iowa Wolves (2022–2023)=== On December 8, 2022, Ryan signed a two-way contract with the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]].{{cite web|title=Timberwolves Sign Matt Ryan to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-sign-matt-ryan-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=December 8, 2022|access-date=December 8, 2022}} On September 28, 2023, Ryan re-signed with the Timberwolves on another two-way contract,{{cite web|first=Matt|last=Stanton|title=Timberwolves Announce Training Camp Roster and Information|url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-announce-training-camp-roster-and-information-3|website=NBA.com|date=September 28, 2023|access-date=September 28, 2023}} but was waived on October 20.{{cite web|title=Timberwolves Waive Four Players|url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-waive-four-players-2|website=NBA.com|date=October 20, 2023|access-date=October 20, 2023}} ===New Orleans Pelicans / Birmingham Squadron (2023–2024)=== On October 22, 2023, Ryan was claimed off waivers by the [[New Orleans Pelicans]] and subsequently signed to a two-way contract.{{cite web|title=Pelicans Add Matt Ryan On Two-Way Contract|url=https://gleague.nba.com/news/pelicans-add-matt-ryan-on-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=October 22, 2023|access-date=October 30, 2023}} On November 2, Ryan had his first NBA start against the Pistons and on April 13, 2024, he signed a standard contract with the Pelicans.{{cite web|title=Pelicans convert Matt Ryan to standard NBA contract|url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/pelicans-convert-matt-ryan-to-standard-nba-contract|website=NBA.com|date=April 13, 2024|access-date=April 13, 2024}} On August 24, he was waived by the Pelicans,{{cite web|title=New Orleans Pelicans waive Matt Ryan|url=https://www.nba.com/pelicans/news/matt-ryan-forward-waived-new-orleans-pelicans-roster-moves-august-24-2024|website=NBA.com|date=August 24, 2024|access-date=August 27, 2024}} but was on October 11.{{cite web|title=New Orleans Pelicans announce roster waived Ryan.{{cite web |title=Knicks Cut Matt Ryan, Jacob Toppin |url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2025/03/knicks-cut-matt-ryan-jacob-toppin.html |website=Hoops Rumors |access-date=March 9, 2025
